ourStory.title: Bringing TCM External Therapies into Modern Australian Communities
ourStory.p1: The Chinese Medicine External Therapies Association is dedicated to inheriting and promoting the rich wisdom and practice of TCM external therapies, including acupuncture, massage, cupping, gua sha, moxibustion, herbal application, and aromatherapy.
ourStory.p2: We believe that conditioning from the outside in can support the balance of Qi and blood, stimulate the body's own recovery potential, and promote more comprehensive physical and mental health.

items.title: Inheritance
items.desc: Preserve and disseminate the knowledge, experience, and cultural value of TCM external therapies.
